name: Buy the fortress disguise

evidence.note: Budget for a bronze med helm and iron chainbody.

name: Pick a cabbage at the monastery

evidence.note: Use ordinary cabbage from the monastery patch.

name: Deposit all carried items for the Temple Knights’ trials

evidence.note: Model Falador bank transfer against the full item set used by this draft catalog.

name: Recover the trial loadout from Falador bank

evidence.note: Model Falador bank transfer against the full item set used by this draft catalog.

name: Accept Sir Amik Varze’s assignment

evidence.note: The quest starts at 12 quest points.

name: Enter in disguise and reach the listening grill

evidence.note: Equip the bronze med helm and iron chainbody, use the fortress door, then follow the secret ladders to the grill.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The player reaches the grill inside the fortress.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Wear the disguise at entry and bring food if the knights are dangerous.

name: Listen to the potion discussion

evidence.note: Listen at the grill to learn which cabbage can spoil the potion.

name: Drop an ordinary cabbage through the hole

evidence.note: Use the ordinary cabbage on the hole above the cauldron and watch the result.

name: Report the sabotage to Sir Amik Varze

evidence.note: Amik awards the quest points, coins and the two build 242 combat lamps.

name: Accept the Temple Knights invitation

evidence.note: Speak to Amik after Black Knights’ Fortress and Druidic Ritual.

name: Enter the Temple Knights’ testing grounds

evidence.note: Talk to Tiffy after banking carried and worn items. Test objects and equipment are supplied inside.

name: Pass the five Temple Knights’ tests

evidence.note: Solve the randomly assigned rooms in sequence. Sir Leye’s final hit must use the supplied steel warhammer or bare hands. Tinley’s room requires waiting in place when assigned.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Five consecutive tests are passed and the player returns to Tiffy.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Follow the room-specific instructions. Restart at Tiffy if a trial fails.

name: Receive the Temple Knights induction rewards

evidence.note: Receive the fixed XP, coins, Initiate sallet and the Falador respawn option.

name: Buy a rope and knife for the Sourhog Cave

evidence.note: Budget for one rope and a reusable knife.

name: Read the Draynor noticeboard

evidence.note: Read the notice about Sarah’s missing farmhand.

name: Ask Sarah about the missing farmhand

evidence.note: Find Sarah at the South Falador farm shop.

name: Secure a rope at the Strange Hole

evidence.note: Tie the rope and leave it in place for both visits.

name: Inspect the skeleton in the cave

evidence.note: Search the skeleton and follow the clue back to Draynor.

name: Ask Spria how to fight the sourhog

evidence.note: Spria explains the encounter and supplies reinforced goggles.

name: Defeat Sourhog while wearing the goggles

evidence.note: Wear the reinforced goggles and defeat the sourhog.

planned_outcome.if_unmet: Equip the goggles and bring enough food and ammunition for the fight.

name: Cut off the sourhog’s foot

evidence.note: Use a knife or a suitable slashing weapon to take the trophy.

name: Show Sarah the sourhog trophy

evidence.note: Report the cave investigation to Sarah before speaking to Spria.

name: Receive the Slayer reward from Spria

evidence.note: Receive 1,000 Slayer XP, 5,000 coins and 30 Slayer reward points.

name: Buy materials and tools for Yarlo’s repairs

evidence.note: Estimate a reserve for planks, nails, cloth and reusable tools. Extra nails cover bending.

name: Ask Marlo about a job

evidence.note: Marlo directs the player to Old Man Yarlo.

name: Ask Yarlo what needs replacing

evidence.note: Receive permission to replace the broken furniture.

name: Remove the damaged furniture and old carpet

evidence.note: Clear all seven furniture spots, then report back to Yarlo.

name: Build the ordinary furniture and new carpet

evidence.note: Use the saw and hammer to replace two stools, two tables, the chair and the carpet.

planned_outcome.success_condition: All six standard furniture and carpet spots have been restored.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring additional nails if any bend during construction.

name: Take three waxwood logs from Yarlo’s crate

evidence.note: Search the quest crate for the logs needed for the new bed.

name: Ask the sawmill operator to cut the waxwood

evidence.note: Hand over the three waxwood logs and receive three planks.

name: Build the waxwood bed and report the repairs

evidence.note: Build the bed and report to Yarlo. Record the combined incidental XP from all furniture at this stage.

name: Receive the Rimmington house from Marlo

evidence.note: The housing reward for a player who does not own a house is a Rimmington house.

name: Receive Marlo’s cash reward as an existing homeowner

evidence.note: An existing homeowner receives 1,000 coins in place of a new house.

name: Receive Marlo’s crate and quest rewards

evidence.note: Receive Marlo’s crate, 400 Construction XP and the quest point added in build 242.

name: Open Marlo’s crate

evidence.note: Unpack the Construction supplies and tablets after receiving the crate.

name: Buy an ordinary candle for the tunnels

evidence.note: Budget for one candle. It needs a tinderbox before entering the tunnels.

name: Light the candle in the castle courtyard

evidence.note: Light the candle before entering the tunnels.

name: Buy two complete H.A.M. outfits

evidence.note: Estimate a Grand Exchange reserve for two of all seven pieces.

name: Ask Sigmund and the Duke about the cellar

evidence.note: Start after Goblin Diplomacy and Rune Mysteries.

name: Ask the castle witnesses about the cellar

evidence.note: Check Hans, the Cook and nearby witnesses as needed until someone confirms the sighting.

name: Report the sighting to the Duke

evidence.note: Get permission to investigate the blocked cellar wall.

name: Mine the rubble and climb through

evidence.note: Use a pickaxe on the blockage and climb through with a light source.

name: Take the brooch from the tunnel

evidence.note: Pick up the brooch near the entrance.

name: Show the Duke the brooch

evidence.note: The Duke directs the player to the Varrock Palace library.

name: Find and read the goblin symbol book

evidence.note: Search the library bookcase and read the book before visiting the generals.

name: Ask the generals about the brooch

evidence.note: Show the brooch and learn how to greet the cave goblins.

name: Follow the safe path through the tunnels

evidence.note: Navigate to the mine with a light source. Avoid the tunnel traps that can put out the candle.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The player reaches Mistag with a usable light source.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring a tinderbox to relight the candle if needed and follow the safe tunnel path.

name: Use the Goblin Bow and speak to Mistag

evidence.note: Use the learned emote. Mistag can now guide the player back through the tunnels.

name: Tell the Duke what Mistag said

evidence.note: Report the peaceful goblins and learn what was stolen.

name: Pickpocket Sigmund’s key

evidence.note: Pickpocket the key from Sigmund.

name: Search Sigmund’s chest

evidence.note: Use the key on the nearby chest to find the H.A.M. evidence.

name: Recover the Duke’s silverware in the H.A.M. hideout

evidence.note: Enter through the trapdoor, search the crate and take the silverware.

name: Return the silverware and take the treaty

evidence.note: Give the Duke the silverware and receive the treaty.

name: Deliver the peace treaty to Mistag

evidence.note: Receive 3,000 Mining XP and a ring of life. The mine and Nardok’s shop are available.

name: Pickpocket both sets of H.A.M. clothes

evidence.note: Collect two of each piece using the quest's increased outfit drop rate.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Two complete seven-piece H.A.M. outfits are held.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Keep pickpocketing until both sets are complete. Recover after being caught as needed.

name: Ask Mistag how to help Zanik

evidence.note: Start after The Lost Tribe with the required levels.

name: Meet Zanik in Lumbridge Castle cellar

evidence.note: Ask Zanik to follow the player to the surface.

name: Give Zanik a tour of Lumbridge

evidence.note: Visit the castle and town residents, show Zanik the surface goblins, and finish her dialogue.

name: Give Zanik a disguise and equip the other set

evidence.note: Hand one complete set to Zanik and keep the other set for the player.

name: Investigate the meeting from the stage

evidence.note: Speak to Johanhus and wait near the stage until Zanik finishes the dialogue and finds the passage.

name: Enter the passage and work past the five guards

evidence.note: Coordinate with Zanik to pass the five guards. Listen at the door when the way is clear.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The meeting is overheard and the capture scene has played.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use Zanik’s instructions to recover after being caught.

name: Find Zanik outside the hideout

evidence.note: Leave the hideout and inspect Zanik. Bring her to Juna.

name: Mine the passage to the Lumbridge Swamp Caves

evidence.note: Use the pickaxe on the passage wall and climb through toward Juna.

name: Gather 20 tears of Guthix for Zanik

evidence.note: Speak to Juna with both hands free, collect 20 tears and finish the revival scene.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Zanik is revived and explains the plan at the mill.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Follow Juna’s instructions and gather the full 20 tears.

name: Hide Zanik in the crate and enter the mill cellar

evidence.note: Search the crate, arrange the disguise and descend the mill trapdoor.

name: Defeat the guards and Sigmund

evidence.note: Use melee or magic when Sigmund’s protection prayer permits it.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The guards and Sigmund are defeated.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring sufficient food and a usable melee weapon or runes.

name: Destroy the drilling machine

evidence.note: Smash the drilling machine before leaving.

name: Leave the mill cellar with Zanik

evidence.note: Use the south exit to finish the quest. Receive Thieving and Ranged XP and access to the city and storerooms.

name: Buy an enchanted gem from Turael

evidence.note: Buy the quest component from the Slayer shop.

name: Buy the Commorb materials and pursuit supplies

evidence.note: Estimate enough for a law rune, molten glass, 20 unnoted pure essence and a rope.

name: Buy 20 unnoted rune essence

evidence.note: Reserve coins for the rune essence alternative to pure essence.

name: Ask Sir Tiffy about Temple Knights work

evidence.note: Accept the assignment with 32 quest points and the prior quest progress.

name: Speak to Sir Amik about becoming a squire

evidence.note: Complete the White Knights’ introduction.

name: Report back to Tiffy

evidence.note: Speak to Tiffy after the appointment.

name: Get Sir Amik’s assignment

evidence.note: Sir Amik assigns the pursuit of Solus.

name: Return to Tiffy for a Commorb

evidence.note: Tiffy offers the material handover and cash alternatives.

name: Trade the components for a Commorb

evidence.note: Give Tiffy a law rune, enchanted gem and molten glass.

name: Pay Tiffy 10,000 coins for a Commorb

evidence.note: The cash purchase substitutes for the material handover.

name: Contact Savant with the Commorb

evidence.note: Contact Savant to receive the investigation instructions.

name: Question Lord Daquarius

evidence.note: Ask him where to find Solus.

name: Defeat a Black Knight and question Daquarius again

evidence.note: Defeat one of the nearby knights and then ask Daquarius for the lead.

planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring suitable gear and food for the dungeon approach and the fight.

name: Give the Mage of Zamorak 20 rune essence

evidence.note: Use 20 unnoted rune essence to obtain the Canifis lead.

name: Give the Mage of Zamorak 20 pure essence

evidence.note: Use 20 unnoted pure essence to obtain the Canifis lead.

name: Contact Savant and scan Canifis

evidence.note: Finish Savant’s message upon arrival and scan the area to obtain the first clue.

name: Follow the first variable clue toward the Champions’ Guild

evidence.note: Follow and scan the revealed intermediate stop. End at the Champions’ Guild for the fixed scan.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The intermediate scan reveals the Champions’ Guild lead.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use the clue and the currently available transport. Use the rope and light if the swamp caves are selected.

name: Scan the Champions’ Guild

evidence.note: Use the Commorb inside the guild’s quest point gate.

name: Follow the next variable clue toward the Dorgesh-Kaan mine

evidence.note: Scan the revealed stop before travelling to the fixed mine scan.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The scan reveals the Dorgesh-Kaan mine lead.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Use the clue’s destination and return to the tunnels for the fixed scan.

name: Scan the Dorgesh-Kaan mine

evidence.note: Use the Commorb near Mistag.

name: Follow the last variable clue toward the rune essence mine

evidence.note: Find the revealed stop, scan it, and handle or avoid the summoned knight before the final lead.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The chase ends at the rune essence mine lead.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Follow the clue and leave the summoned knight behind if the encounter is unsafe.

name: Enter the rune essence mine and defeat Solus

evidence.note: Ask Aubury for a teleport, finish the confrontation and return to the shop with Solus’s hat.

planned_outcome.success_condition: Solus is defeated and his hat is available.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Bring combat gear, finish the fight and contact Savant if the hat has to be recovered.

name: Deliver Solus’s hat to Sir Amik

evidence.note: Receive 5,000 Slayer XP and access to the White Knight armoury.

name: Fill a bucket at the castle kitchen

evidence.note: Use the water source near the castle kitchen.

name: Ask Wizard Persten about the amulet

evidence.note: Start after Enter the Abyss and with base Runecraft 10.

name: Ask Herbert about the eye amulet

evidence.note: Show the amulet to the Mage of Zamorak in Varrock and learn what he wants.

name: Ask the tea seller for a strong tea

evidence.note: Ask for the special tea for Herbert.

name: Give Herbert the strong tea

evidence.note: Give Herbert the tea and complete the dialogue so he can send the player to the Abyss.

name: Take Herbert’s one-time teleport to the Abyss

evidence.note: Accept the one-time quest teleport from Varrock into the Abyss.

name: Get the Dark Mage’s attention

evidence.note: Use the water to get his attention and show him the eye amulet.

name: Inspect the active runes and receive the incantation

evidence.note: Follow the order shown by the Abyssal runes and ask the Dark Mage for the written incantation.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The Dark Mage provides the incantation.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Follow the current rune order shown in the quest encounter.

name: Return the amulet to Persten

evidence.note: Give the amulet back to Persten and show the incantation.

name: Take Persten’s teleport to the Wizards’ Tower

evidence.note: Ask Persten to send the player to the tower.

name: Show the incantation to Sedridor

evidence.note: Bring the incantation to the basement archmage.

name: Speak to the apprentices and solve Traiborn’s puzzle

evidence.note: Speak to Traiborn and the three apprentices, then answer his puzzle.

name: Perform the incantation with Sedridor

evidence.note: Return downstairs, deliver the incantation and watch the portal open.

name: Enter the quest portal to the Temple of the Eye

evidence.note: Use the portal and finish the arrival scene.

name: Talk to the apprentices and investigate the temple

evidence.note: Visit each apprentice, report to Persten and finish the vision and debrief.

name: Complete the Guardians of the Rift tutorial

evidence.note: Use the provided tools if needed, craft and deposit guardian stones, and complete the tutorial. Record the combined in-quest Runecraft XP here. The tutorial returns the player to Sedridor.

planned_outcome.success_condition: The tutorial has closed the rift and the Great Guardian’s dialogue has finished.
planned_outcome.if_unmet: Follow the tutorial instructions and finish the encounter before leaving.

name: Report to Sedridor after the tutorial

evidence.note: Sedridor grants 5,000 Runecraft XP and the medium pouch. The minigame is unlocked.
